controls.title: Security governance review
controls.objective: Review the organizational security governance system for continued suitability and effectiveness.

controls.title: Security risk assessment and register
controls.objective: Identify, evaluate, assign, treat, and review material security risks.

controls.title: Account provisioning and removal
controls.objective: Grant and remove access according to authorized business need.

controls.title: Privileged access review
controls.objective: Review privileged accounts and authority for continued necessity and appropriateness.

controls.title: Governed software engineering
controls.objective: Software developed by Iron Signal Systems operates under an accepted engineering assurance standard.

controls.title: Vulnerability identification and remediation
controls.objective: Identify applicable vulnerabilities, assign disposition, and verify remediation or bounded exception.

controls.title: Security incident response
controls.objective: Prepare for, identify, contain, investigate, recover from, and review security incidents.

controls.title: Business continuity and recovery
controls.objective: Maintain and exercise recovery capabilities proportionate to operational risk.

controls.title: Supplier security review
controls.objective: Assess material suppliers before use and periodically thereafter.

controls.title: Information and system inventory
controls.objective: Maintain an inventory of material information systems, services, repositories, and operational dependencies.

controls.title: Security awareness
controls.objective: Provide security awareness appropriate to personnel responsibilities.

controls.title: Security exception governance
controls.objective: Ensure exceptions are explicit, authorized, bounded, reviewed, and not silently perpetual.
